Class DecodeCudaGraphSession

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.engine.DecodeCudaGraphSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class DecodeCudaGraphSession extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Per-device CUDA graph session for uniform decode (batch 1 or power-of-two B).

Graphs are bucketed by (batch, numPages). Within a bucket, last_page_len and per-row KV indices are updated in place before replay(int).
